label: Waterproof Vinyl
subtitle: Supplied individually with gloss or matt finish
description: Our die cut stickers are one of the most popular products we sell! They are printed and cut out to die-cut individual stickers which are great for handing out at events or including in packages. We can cut your die cut stickers to any custom shape you require, and supply with a matt or a gloss finish! Use our interactive sticker builder below to build your die cut custom stickers and buy online. Our die cut stickers are a very popular choice with our customers. The material they are cut from is a waterproof vinyl material which is suitable to be used both indoors and outdoors. We supply these stickers cut out as individual stickers and sent out in packs.

label: Clear Waterproof Vinyl
subtitle: Available in clear gloss or clear frosted matt
description: Clear vinyl stickers and labels are transparent giving them an 'invisible' look for great effects when printed! We can print opaque white inks onto our transparent vinyl material. You can either have just white ink on your stickers, white ink and colour or have a white base layer to your colours to make them stand out. Clear Waterproof stickers are printed onto a transparent vinyl that is resistant to water and other liquids. These stickers are the same as our white waterproof stickers but the background / unprinted areas are transparent. They are often used in outdoor or wet environments, such as on water bottles, boats, outdoor equipment or any sort of product where the label may get wet. Our waterproof stickers are printed using UV resistant inks which prevents your sticker from fading when exposed to sunlight.

label: Block Out Vinyl
subtitle: Correction labels, available in a matt or gloss finish
description: Our block out vinyl stickers are perfect if you need to cover a mistake on something you already have printed. The adhesive on these stickers is grey, which blocks out light and stops anything showing through. This material is available in a gloss or a matt finish, and can be cut to any shape or size you need.

label: Laminated Stickers
subtitle: White heavy duty durable printed stickers
description: White Laminated vinyl stickers are our most durable stickers we offer. They are printed onto our opaque white waterproof vinyl material and then a clear layer of vinyl is applied to the surface, protecting the print from any scuffs or damage. We offer this material in a permanent, removable or extra permanent adhesive if you are looking for a super strong hold! We also offer clear laminated vinyl if you want the stickers to be transparent. Laminated stickers are ideal if you want a hard wearing durable sticker for when the sticker is going to be handled or come into contact with potentially heavy objects.

label: Clear Laminated Stickers
subtitle: Transparent heavy duty durable printed stickers
description: Clear / Transparent Laminated vinyl stickers are one of our most durable stickers we offer. They are printed onto our clear waterproof vinyl material and then a clear layer of vinyl is applied to the surface, protecting the print from any scuffs or damage. We offer this material in a permanent adhesive along with a matt or a gloss finish. We also offer white laminated vinyl if you want the stickers to be opaque. Laminated stickers are ideal if you want a hard wearing durable sticker for when the sticker is going to be handled or come into contact with potentially heavy objects.

label: High Tack Stickers
subtitle: Super sticky labels, in a matt or gloss finish
description: Our high tack custom vinyl stickers are for when you need that extra strong stick and to survive the elements! These personalised vinyl stickers will stick to almost anything, from wood to low energy surfaces like ABS. Due to its extreme high tack extra permanent adhesive, the stickers will adhere to surfaces for a longer period of time than standard permanent adhesive. You can configure your stickers below, and have the option to choose between a matt or a gloss finish.

Our metallic stickers are fully waterproof, can be used both indoors and outdoors (UV resistant), and available in any shape or size! label: Fluorescent
subtitle: Available in a fluorescent red, green, orange, yellow and pink
description: Our printed fluorescent stickers & labels are perfect for catching someone's eye! Fluorescent stickers, also commonly referred to as neon stickers, are widely used in advertising and promotions as they attract instant attention and stand out above the rest. We stock fluorescent stickers in 5 bright neon colours: Red, Green, Orange, Pink and Yellow and are now available to be cut to any shape or size on either a waterproof vinyl or a premium paper material.

label: Kraft Paper
subtitle: Ribbed kraft effect labels and stickers, supplied on sheets
description: Our Ribbed Kraft effect material is a unique textured paper material that mimics the look and feel of traditional kraft paper. It is made from paper that gives it a ribbed or corrugated texture, as well as a natural, earthy look. This material is perfect for creating a rustic, vintage, or eco-friendly aesthetic for products, packaging, and marketing materials. We can print and cut kraft stickers to any shape or size, which can be configured using the product builder below.

label: Biodegradable Paper
subtitle: Available in a biodegradable white or natural finish
description: Biodegradable paper stickers are a type of label that is made from natural, environmentally friendly materials. They are available in a natural or a white finish. A natural high-quality paper-like material made from agricultural waste (leaves and stems). These stickers are designed to break down over time, reducing their impact on the environment. The fibers in the paper give it a unique texture and appearance that mimics the look and feel of traditional paper. The fibers are often visible on the surface of the paper, giving it a natural, organic appearance.
specs: Regulations: Compostability: facestock + BioTak adhesive are EN13432 certified (Natural PaperWise). Backing liner is recyclable kraft (not EN13432).

label: Antique Paper
subtitle: Eco-friendly textured paper stickers
description: Antique laid paper stickers are a type of decorative label that is made to look like it is made from an old-fashioned, textured paper. They may feature a variety of designs, such as vintage illustrations or ornate calligraphy. The "laid" in the name refers to the distinct linear pattern created by the parallel lines in the paper, which is a characteristic of traditional paper-making methods used in the past. These stickers can be used to add a touch of nostalgia or vintage charm to any products.

label: Premium Paper
description: Our custom-printed paper stickers and labels are our most cost-effective option, available in any custom size or shape. High quality and highly universal - typical uses include branding jam jars, cosmetic product labels and personalised candles. Supplied on sheets.

label: Transparent Foiled
subtitle: Clear stickers with a gold, silver, rose gold or rainbow foil
description: Our transparent stickers can be foiled in 4 colours: Silver, Rose Gold, Gold or Rainbow metallic! Use our interactive builder to custom build your foiled stickers below! We can foil anything you like onto these transparent waterproof stickers! Whether it be your logo, fancy text, social media icons we can do it. You can also have the whole sticker foiled and leave specific areas you would like to be transparent for really amazing effects. These foiled stickers come with a permanent self adhesive backing, so you simply peel them away from the sheet and stick where you please

label: Paper Foiled
subtitle: Paper stickers with a gold, silver, rose gold or rainbow foil
description: Foil paper stickers are becoming a really popular choice, with the ability to create extremely high end looking stickers at affordable prices. Our premium paper foil stickers can be foiled in 4 colours: Silver, Rose Gold, Gold or Rainbow metallic! No matter what colour you choose, foil stickers are a great way to make your brand message stand out from the rest. Popular uses for custom foil stickers include as a finish to your postage, packaging, and promotions. Best of all is we can foil anything you like onto these foiled stickers! Whether it be your logo, fancy text, social media icons we can do it.
specs: Regulations: The adhesive conforms to the EN71-3 (Toy Safety) & Packaging Regulations.

label: Waterproof Foiled
subtitle: Waterproof stickers with a gold, silver, rose gold or rainbow foil
description: Our white waterproof stickers can be foiled in 4 colours: Gold, Silver, Rose Gold or Rainbow metallic! Use our interactive builder to custom build your foiled stickers below! We can foil anything you like onto these waterproof stickers! Whether it be your logo, fancy text, social media icons we can do it. You can also have the whole sticker foiled and leave specific areas you would like to be white paper for really amazing effects. Our white waterproof material comes in a gloss or a matt finish, and the foil itself would be gloss. These foiled stickers come with a permanent self adhesive backing, so you simply peel them away from the sheet and stick where you please
